svg.title: Lattice-boom crawler crane — Beltakrani með grindarbómu
svg.desc: A tracked crane carries an open lattice boom and an unladen hook suspended clear of its carrier.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-crawler-lattice-crane","label_en":"Lattice-boom crawler crane","label_is":"Beltakrani með grindarbómu","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","crane"],"description":"A tracked crane carries an open lattice boom and an unladen hook suspended clear of its carrier.","design_note":"The open lattice boom and freely hanging hook identify lifting machinery rather than a dragline bucket.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
